initial_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE companion RED JOKER closely matching the supplied finished BLACK JOKER from Chinese-themed Design 2. Input is the authoritative style and layout reference.
Keep full 5:7 portrait card, 1060x1484 target, ivory margins, gold lotus-vine frame, same ivory index cartouches, dense BLACK interior fields of teal foliage and red/ivory lotus blossoms, scalloped ivory central reserve and pale-gold tracery. Same painted silk embroidery, natural warm face modeling, fine linework, figure scale and matching double-ended waist-up composition joined at central turquoise lotus jewel.
Change the outer band from black to deep Madder Lake RED, keeping all ivory/gold vines. Change both JOKER indices to RED. Keep the same five serif letters J O K E R stacked in upper-left; lower-right is their true 180-degree rotation. No suit symbols or other words.
The entertainer is a companion adult Chinese man of about 35, clean-shaven, cheerful knowing smile, wearing the same soft folded black cloth cap with small gold lotus clasp. Upper face gently turns toward VIEWER'S LEFT with both eyes visible; lower face consequently angles toward PAGE RIGHT. Rich MADDER RED silk robe with teal/gold lotus embroidery, dark teal sash, ivory cuff lining, modest gold tassels. No crown, imperial cap, European jester horns or clown makeup.
REPLACE BOTH FANS COMPLETELY with small Chinese-inspired handheld pellet drums: circular ivory drumskin seen slightly obliquely, short cylindrical red lacquer rim with gold details, a modest short dark wooden handle held on the upper figure's VIEWER RIGHT at chest/shoulder height; TWO short cords attached to opposite sides of the rim, each terminating in one small round bead. Drum diameter about the width of the face. One subtle red/gold lotus on its ivory face. The instrument must read as a small rattle drum, not a weapon, fan, scepter, tambourine or giant gong. No writing on drum. Other hand rests in a relaxed playful gesture at the sash. Lower half repeats same person, pose and drum rotated 180 degrees; lower instrument on PAGE LEFT. All props fully inside inner frame. Preserve dense floral ornament and generous breathing room around the head. Output one full flat card, no mockup, watermark, signature.
